about: Shapes of the local API for the twins' skills on the owner's linked computers (routes /fleet/skills*). Same rules as api_shapes.json and tasks_shapes.json: required keys are always present, optional keys may be absent, closed shapes carry no other key. Checked against the page's fixtures in tests/desktop/skills.mjs.

SkillsSync.route: GET /fleet/skills; also the answer of POST /fleet/skills/switch, /fleet/skills/item, /fleet/skills/keep and /fleet/skills/restore
SkillsSync.note: role: source (this computer shares its twins' skills) | follower (it takes them) | none (nothing to show; the page draws nothing). on: this computer's own switch, off by default. state: off | on | waiting | off_there | older_there | not_linked. what: one sentence, ready to show, saying what goes between the computers and what never does. message: the state in a sentence, ready to show, or empty. other: the computer at the other end (a linked computer: the one that shares; null on the sharing computer). undo: only after keep and restore, the version that puts back what that act replaced (null when nothing was replaced)

SkillsTwin.note: id: t- and 16 hex digits, the twin's id in GET /fleet

Skill.note: key: the skill's folder below the twin's skills folder, one or two plain names (group/name). state: in_sync | off | only_here | changed_here | conflict | waiting | too_big | removed_there | error. label and note: ready to show. on: the sharing computer shares this skill; a linked computer follows it (false there: only on this computer). switch_label: the spoken name of the row's switch. choices: empty unless the owner has a choice to make. versions: newest first, 10 at most

SkillChoice.note: keep: mine | theirs. label: the button's words, ready to show

SkillVersion.note: vid: k- and 12 hex digits (what a change replaced on this computer) or v and a number (a version the sharing computer sent out). label: ready to show
